description: This is a PHP class 'ReportGeneratorDao' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Dao'. It provides data access methods for managing reports, including fetching, saving, deleting, and querying report-related entities such as display fields, filter fields, report groups, and associated entities in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorDao
classes.description: Provides data access layer functionalities for report management including CRUD operations, fetching report entities, and supporting report filtering and pagination within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Fetches DisplayField entities selected for a specific report by report ID.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldGroupIdsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of DisplayFieldGroup entities associated with a report.

methods.name: getSelectedCompositeDisplayFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves CompositeDisplayField entities linked to a report.

methods.name: getSelectedFilterFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Fetches SelectedFilterField entities associated with a report.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves a Report entity by its ID.

methods.name: getSummaryDisplayFieldByReportId
methods.description: Fetches SummaryDisplayField entities linked to a report.

methods.name: saveReport
methods.description: Saves or updates a Report entity and its associated display groups, display fields, and filter fields within a transaction.

methods.name: saveSelectedFilterField
methods.description: Persists an array of SelectedFilterField entities.

methods.name: saveSelectedDisplayField
methods.description: Creates and persists SelectedDisplayField entities for a report based on provided IDs.

methods.name: saveSelectedDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Creates and persists SelectedDisplayFieldGroup entities for a report.

methods.name: getFilterFieldByName
methods.description: Fetches a FilterField entity by its name.

methods.name: searchPimDefinedReports
methods.description: Executes a search for PIM-defined reports based on filter parameters, utilizing pagination.

methods.name: getSearchPimDefinedReportsPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator for searching PIM reports.

methods.name: getSearchPimDefinedReportCount
methods.description: Returns the count of PIM reports matching search filters.

methods.name: deletePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Deletes reports by IDs within the PIM report group.

methods.name: getReportById
methods.description: Fetches a report by ID, returning null if nonexistent.

methods.name: getExistingReportIdsForPim
methods.description: Retrieves report IDs for reports within the PIM report group matching a list of IDs.

methods.name: getReportGroupByName
methods.description: Fetches a ReportGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: deleteExistingReportRecordsByReportId
methods.description: Deletes associated entities (display fields, filter fields) for a report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Deletes SelectedDisplayFieldGroup entities for a report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedDisplayFields
methods.description: Deletes SelectedDisplayField entities for a report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedFilterFields
methods.description: Deletes SelectedFilterField entities for a report.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldIdsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves display field IDs associated with a report.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldIdsByReportGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves display field IDs for a report filtered by display group ID.

methods.name: getIncludeType
methods.description: Fetches the SelectedFilterField related to the 'include' filter for a report.

methods.name: isIncludeHeader
methods.description: Determines if a display group is marked as a header for a report.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldGroupIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of display field group IDs associated with a report.

methods.name: getSkippedSelectedFilterFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Fetches filter fields that are marked to be skipped for a report.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Fetches all display field groups.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFields
methods.description: Fetches all display fields with an associated display group.

methods.name: getAllFilterFields
methods.description: Fetches all filter fields excluding the 'include' filter and only those with 'pim' report group.
